# Origin

This project is a modern Fortran translation of computational concepts and public behavior from the R package **Matrix 1.7-6**.

- Upstream package: Matrix
- Upstream version: 1.7-6
- Upstream source date: 2026-07-24
- Upstream URL listed by the package: https://codeberg.org/jaganmn/Matrix
- Source snapshot: `original/Matrix-1.7-6/`

The Fortran sources are a changed work and are not maintained or endorsed by the upstream Matrix authors.
